title: **TOURNAMENT REPORT** Semi-Finals at "The Cookout" cEDH Tournament. Tymna Kraum Blue Farm Combo MTG
description:
I made the Top 16 Semi-Finals of "The Cookout" cEDH (competitive commander) tournament with Tymna/Kraum Blue Farm! This 160-person, paper cEDH tournament was run by Eminence Gaming on July 29 and 30, 2023 in Atlanta, Georgia. I played my trusty Tymna, the Weaver and Kraum, Ludevic's Opus partner commanders at the helm of the fearsome Underworld Breach/Thassa's Oracle/Ad Nauseam combo-control deck. This report takes you through my deck, tuning process, and the tournament rounds. MTG EDH
